column3: “Your reward shall be very great” may also be rendered “your very great reward.”
“Lord GOD” renders “Adonai YHWH.” “the heir of my house” renders an obscure phrase, literally “the son of possession of my house.”
“one born in my house” renders “a son of my house.”
“terror and great darkness” renders “dread, great darkness.”
“strangers” renders “sojourners,” and “they will be enslaved and oppressed” renders “they will serve them, and they will afflict them.”
“a smoking oven” renders “a fire pot of smoke.”
“I have given” renders the Hebrew perfect, a promise stated as done.
